subvaginal.definition:
a. Situated under or inside a sheath or vaginal membrane;
   as, the subvaginal, or subdural, spaces about the optic nerve.
subvaginal.translation: [医] 鞘下的; 阴道下的

subvariety.definition: n. A subordinate variety, or a division of a variety.
subvariety.translation:
n. 亚变种
[医] 亚变种, 亚类

subvene.definition: v. i. To come under, as a support or stay; to happen.

subvening.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Subvene
subvening.translation: v. <罕>前来救助, 前来支援( subvene的现在分词 )

subvention.definition:
n. grant of financial aid as from a government to an educational institution
n. the act or process of providing aid or help of any sort
subvention.translation:
n. 补助金, 津贴, 援助
[经] 补助金, 津贴

subvention for regular services.translation: [经] 定期补助, 定期服役津贴

subventionize.definition: v. t. To come to the aid of; to subsidize; to support.

subventions.definition:
plural of subvention
n. grant of financial aid as from a government to an educational institution

subventions.translation:

plural of subversion

n a radical supporter of political or social revolution
s in opposition to a civil authority or government

a. 从事颠覆的, 破坏性的
n. 破坏分子, 颠覆分子
